{{Quote|There is a little known group of mercenaries on Endor known as the Jantsk Mercenaries. You will approach their leader on my behalf. He is expecting you, but those in his employ must not know that the Empire is hiring them.|[[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], to an Imperial spacer|<ref name="SWG:TEatQ" />}}
The '''Jantsk mercenaries''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. It was named after its leader, [[Vurrha Jantsk]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Jantsk and his mercenaries went to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in order to attack [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Kylantha]]'s chambers. Unbeknownst to his men, Jantsk and his group had been hired by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] himself for this mission. When the job was done, their leader was assassinated by an unidentified [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] on the Emperor's orders.<ref name="SWG:TEatQ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jantsk mercenaries appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TEatQ" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Jantsk mercenaries were added to the game with the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Imperial Theme Park|Imperial Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:TEatQ" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Update Notes 6.12: September 13 2007|Chapter 6.12]]" update, on [[September 13]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67417&month=092007|text=Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
